description: This file defines the CreateSnapshotAction struct and associated methods to handle creating snapshots within the Android Cuttlefish orchestrator. It includes functions for initializing the action, executing the snapshot creation process, and interacting with the CVD CLI to manage VM snapshots.

classes.name: CreateSnapshotAction
classes.description: Struct representing an action to create a snapshot in the Android Cuttlefish orchestrator, encapsulating necessary parameters and CLI interactions.

methods.name: NewCreateSnapshotAction
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a new CreateSnapshotAction with specified options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the snapshot creation process asynchronously, returning an operation handle.

methods.name: createSnapshot
methods.description: Performs the steps to suspend the VM, take a snapshot, and resume the VM, returning the snapshot response.
